keyPoints.en: Unicellular organisms rely on diffusion; large multicellular organisms need transport systems.
keyPoints.bm: Organisma unisel bergantung pada resapan; organisma multisel yang besar memerlukan sistem pengangkutan.

keyPoints.en: Fish: single circulation. Humans and other mammals: double circulation.
keyPoints.bm: Ikan: peredaran tunggal. Manusia dan mamalia lain: peredaran berganda.

keyPoints.en: Heart: right side pumps deoxygenated blood to the lungs; left side pumps oxygenated blood to the body.
keyPoints.bm: Jantung: sisi kanan mengepam darah terdeoksigen ke peparu; sisi kiri mengepam darah beroksigen ke badan.

keyPoints.en: Arteries: thick, elastic, high pressure. Veins: valves, low pressure. Capillaries: one cell thick for exchange.
keyPoints.bm: Arteri: tebal, kenyal, tekanan tinggi. Vena: berinjap, tekanan rendah. Kapilari: setebal satu sel untuk pertukaran.

keyPoints.en: Exercise, a balanced diet and not smoking keep the heart and blood vessels healthy.
keyPoints.bm: Senaman, diet seimbang dan tidak merokok memastikan jantung dan salur darah sihat.

keyPoints.en: Blood = plasma + red blood cells + white blood cells + platelets.
keyPoints.bm: Darah = plasma + sel darah merah + sel darah putih + platlet.

keyPoints.en: ABO groups: O can donate to all; AB can receive from all (ABO only — other factors are also checked).
keyPoints.bm: Kumpulan ABO: O boleh menderma kepada semua; AB boleh menerima daripada semua (ABO sahaja — faktor lain turut disemak).

keyPoints.en: Xylem carries water and minerals up; phloem carries food (translocation).
keyPoints.bm: Xilem mengangkut air dan mineral ke atas; floem mengangkut makanan (translokasi).

keyPoints.en: Transpiration pulls water up; it increases with light, heat and wind, and decreases with humidity.
keyPoints.bm: Transpirasi menarik air ke atas; ia meningkat dengan cahaya, haba dan angin, serta berkurang dengan kelembapan.
